text:
anna: Heads up — deploybot failed to promote the staging image to eu cluster during the 10:00-11:00 change window. It looks like the EU ECR mirror skipped provenance annotation for the build.
ben: saw the alert. Which image? sha or tag?
anna: tag=release-1.42.0-eu, digest=sha256:3a7f...c9b
deploybot: Promotion blocked: missing provenance annotation for image release-1.42.0-eu (sha256:3a7f...c9b) in eu-west-1. See: https://deploy.internal/release/1716123456 :warning:
olga: ugh, that's the backfill job we kicked overnight. maybe multipart upload finished before attestation webhook.
sam: quick check: can we re-run the attestation-only job? or do we need to retag+push?
ben: attestation-only should be possible if the layer is still present. try: 
```sh
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/release --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:3a7f...c9b --registry-id 111222333444 --region eu-west-1
```
ben: if it returns the manifest we can re-run provenance lambda to emit attestation annotation.
anna: I ran that and it returned manifest, but deploybot still rejects because the manifest lacks cosign annotation key `cosign.sigstore.dev/provenance`.
olga: ok I'll trigger the attestation job now (attest-job/1716123600).
olga: attest-job started. ETA ~2m.
deploybot: attest-job/1716123600 reported success. Added annotation cosign.sigstore.dev/provenance to sha256:3a7f...c9b.
sam: beautiful. Try promote again please.
anna: re-invoking promote command: `/deploy promote release-1.42.0-eu --to=eu-cluster --canary=10%`
deploybot: Promotion queued. Pre-checks: OK. Starting rollout.
ben: leaving canary in place for 30m, watching latency and error-rate. if any regressed we'll rollback.
anna: also updating release notes snippet: "EU mirror attestation backfilled; no change to user-facing behavior." Will add a note about the window.
olga: quick follow-up: we should add a guard to the backfill job to wait for attestation webhook completion or retry on missing annotation. Filed: ARCH-451 (assign olga).
sam: agree — also add a metric to the mirror pipeline: missing-attestation-count.
anna: ok closing the thread — rollout progressing. ping me if canary goes bad. :thumbsup:
